notes.title: New amenities and news about the release version of the game
notes.content:
The new update is already in the game! We have added comfort to the game, namely:
- The compass has been completely redesigned and the ability to put a mark on the map has been added.
- Corrected the plot. Now it is more pleasant to read it.
- The number of beds has been increased. Now the ability to sleep has appeared in all buildings.

We also want to note that the writing of the script for the release version of the game is about 65% complete. And the creation of new code is actively underway.
If you are interested in what will be in the release version of the game, then we strongly recommend that you familiarize yourself with our plans for 2021.
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1339870/view/2939128625242217064

notes.title: Alpha version 0.3 is already in the game!
notes.content:
The new update is already in the game! A lot of interesting things have been added, namely:
- Changed the desert map. Now, instead of the endless desert, you will be in the Wild West.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38273577/dd5031caccd4a617bb687423c256c0e405b9de7d.jpg[/img]
- Edited plot. It has become more intense and voluminous.
- Fixed many bugs.
- A simplified mode that will help you find a clue to get out of the illusion.
We encourage you to review our plans for the game for 2021.
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1339870/view/2939128625242217064

notes.title: Plans for 2021!
notes.content:
Hello friends!
In this post, we would like to tell you about our plans for 2021! The game will change dramatically this year, we have a lot of great ideas that you will love!
Some of them:
- New plot
- Completely redesigned map. It will be much larger than the current map, there will be a completely different type of forest, many abandoned settlements will appear, and there will also be a post-apocalyptic city
- Most of the map will be patrolled by the military
- Dynamic weather
- Personal transport from the main character
- Fully updated illusions, which will have their own micro-plots and an action plan leading to the battle with the main enemy
- A completely new soundtrack for the game
- Large variety of shotguns and their customization
- Pumping abilities of the main character
- 5 more languages ​​will appear. There will be 10 of them in total.
- Added voice acting for the main character, as well as his opponents

The current version of the game will not be forgotten, no global updates are planned, but we will fix bugs and supplement it in every possible way.
You can follow the development process on the Steam store page, as well as in other ways:
YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCh5GY4kSa7RRDg1A5MrjelQ
Twitter: https://twitter.com/NGOG76525050
The first news will be in the summer of 2021.

notes.title: Alpha version 0.2 is already in the game!
notes.content:
The new update is already in the game! A lot of interesting things have been added, namely:
- The water map has been changed. It has become more colorful and rich.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38273577/be5ec8f658143684aabfde3d1c2b9187e20b846b.png[/img]
- Several trains have been added to the train tracks where items can be found.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38273577/cc8eb920d7180bae8883e6a487237b031cf65497.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38273577/6b1fe68e2e8ba0c08dc8872e174a8846f74ca755.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38273577/662df927ae1ce43b942bd045039dcd2ff0078225.png[/img]
- Sleep. Your character now needs sleep. In the late afternoon there will be a desire to sleep, and if you do not find a bed in time, you will go crazy.
- New system for generating items in backpacks.
- The bug with the appearance of the enemy has been fixed.
- Many bugs were fixed, as well as some subtleties thought out.

notes.title: Alpha version!
notes.content:
The new global update is already in the game! A lot of interesting things have been added, namely:
- New inventory. It is practical and easy to use.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38273577/92e0a842b1ac44a6af2161147dc36def723f14bb.png[/img]
- Completely updated storyline.
- Provisions. You now have food and water indicators. You can satisfy hunger and dehydration with the help of canned food, water bottles, drink an energy drink that will replenish the stamina and cold indicator. You can find all this in abandoned houses, in the forest, in backpacks. You can also find a jacket that will completely stop the frost.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38273577/a57d487ad385ceaf01800eab973c7141a47d0af8.png[/img]
- New interface design.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38273577/4bb075da8344f245ee396989aa241526a9816b84.jpg[/img]
- Cameras. You can install cameras throughout the forest, they will help you keep track of your opponent.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38273577/54403a2a6bb2a1f65e0bca31363421af232f4ea9.png[/img]
- New map, tropical jungle.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38273577/2345f8feeba3958b419477e9c8386889045f400e.png[/img]
- Completely updated one of the maps. Instead of a dead desert, you fight at the foot of an active volcano.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38273577/40c263e47939706a3859b3e6fe0f804ae404d774.png[/img]
- Three new languages: French, Spanish, German.
- More abandoned settlements have appeared on the main map.

If you would like to talk to the developer directly, then write to this email address, which is regularly viewed: NGOG-Corporation2020@yandex.ru
You can follow us on Twitter: https://twitter.com/NGOG76525050

notes.title: Scheduled release date for the global update!
notes.content:
On October 10-20, we plan to release a global update that will bring the game to the alpha version. 
If you want to talk to the developer directly, write to this email address, which is regularly viewed: NGOG-Corporation2020@yandex.ru

notes.title: The process of working on a Global update
notes.content:
We have begun work on an update that will fundamentally change the game! Right now we will tell you what will happen in the alpha version of the game.

The game will add:
- Complete survival system. That is, there will be an opportunity: to drink, eat, look for backpacks,
drink an energy drink stopping the freezing of the character for a while, and you can also find a jacket that will completely stop the freeze 
- Artificial intelligence in animals. You can hunt them, search the burrows of one of the animals.
- Two new maps (you can see one of them in the screenshot)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38273577/d3e521eb677e37fa04ac7222562267de8f4b00ca.png[/img]
- There will be devices with which you can hunt the main enemy
- New icon design
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38273577/4bb075da8344f245ee396989aa241526a9816b84.jpg[/img]
- 3 new languages
- New font

If you want to look at the development process, we recommend that you subscribe to our Twitter account, where we will publish reports on the work: https://twitter.com/NGOG76525050
